Yard signs, round two

Five richer directions, each in a different typeface pairing. Texture, foil gold, framing and a photographic option. Still 24 × 18 in, phone sized for a car at 40 feet, website for a walker at 10.

Type board

The same number and line in six display serifs (for the headline and phone) and four sans faces (for the website and small print). Cormorant and Inter are what the site uses today.
